text:
```yaml
name: Extension Publish Marketplace

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: npm

      - name: Markdown linting
        run: npm run lint:md

      - name: Spell checking
        run: npm run spell-check

      - name: Frontmatter validation
        run: npm run lint:frontmatter

      - name: Skill structure validation
        run: npm run validate:skills

      - name: Markdown link validation
        run: npm run lint:md-links

      - name: PowerShell analysis
        run: npm run lint:ps

      - name: Plugin freshness
        run: npm run plugin:generate
```
